title: 液態調諧阻尼器~Tuned liquid dampers
focus: 以水槽晃動頻率、有效水量與水頭損失阻尼，把高樓風致加速度降到舒適度門檻內~Sloshing frequency, effective water mass and head-loss damping that bring tall-building wind acceleration within comfort limits
summary: 從住宅與辦公塔樓的風致舒適度出發，用線性波浪理論決定淺水槽的晃動頻率與參與水量，用 U 形液柱公式設計液柱阻尼器，再處理閘門與阻尼網的振幅相依阻尼、屋頂水槽結構與分階段注水、以水深現場調頻、縮尺振動台試驗與完工監測，最後談蒸發補水、出水高度與交接，並以 Comcast Center、One Wall Centre 與 One Rincon Hill 的公開資料對照。~Starting from wind comfort in residential and office towers, use linear wave theory to set the sloshing frequency and participating water of shallow tanks and the U-tube formula to size liquid-column dampers, then handle amplitude-dependent damping from gates and screens, rooftop tank structures and staged filling, field tuning by water depth, scaled shaking-table tests and post-completion monitoring, and finally evaporation, freeboard and handover, compared with public information on Comcast Center, One Wall Centre and One Rincon Hill.

units.title: 風致舒適度與液體阻尼器選型~Wind comfort and choosing a liquid damper
units.mechanism: 液態調諧阻尼器（TLD）把水裝在頂部水槽中，讓水面晃動的第一模態頻率對準建築主模態；建築擺動時水的晃動落後約 90 度相位，水對槽壁的動壓力就成為與結構速度反向的控制力，碎波與阻尼網再把能量轉成熱。與鋼擺錘相比，它沒有軸承與吊索，造價低、維護簡單，水還能兼作消防或給水備用，但只有一部分水真正參與晃動，同樣效果需要較多總水量。住宅塔樓若風洞預測的頂層加速度超過舒適度門檻，水槽型阻尼器常比加厚核心筒便宜。~A tuned liquid damper (TLD) holds water in rooftop tanks whose first sloshing frequency is tuned to the building's governing mode. As the tower sways the sloshing lags by roughly 90 degrees, so the dynamic water pressure on the tank walls becomes a control force opposing structural velocity, while wave breaking and damping screens turn energy into heat. Compared with a steel pendulum it has no bearings or hangers, costs less and is simpler to maintain, and the water can double as a fire or domestic reserve; however, only part of the water actually sloshes, so the same effect needs more total water. When wind-tunnel predictions put top-floor acceleration above the comfort threshold in a residential tower, a tank damper is often cheaper than thickening the core.
units.model: 所需有效質量 m_eff = μ·M*。取第一模態廣義質量 M* = 30,000 t、目標質量比 μ = 1.5%，m_eff = 450 t；若淺水槽只有約 78.5% 的水參與第一晃動模態，總水量約 450/0.785 ≈ 573 t，約等於 573 m³ 的水。數值為教學假設。~The required effective mass is m_eff = μ·M*. With a first-mode generalised mass M* = 30,000 t and a target mass ratio μ = 1.5%, m_eff = 450 t; if only about 78.5% of the water in a shallow tank joins the first sloshing mode, the total water is about 450/0.785 ≈ 573 t, roughly 573 m³. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 要求風洞報告分別給出無阻尼器與加裝 TLD（以等效阻尼比表示）時，1 年與 10 年回歸期的頂層尖峰加速度，與 ISO 10137 或 AIJ 居住性曲線比較；同時由結構設計者確認屋頂樓板與轉換梁能承受水槽滿水加上晃動動壓的荷重組合。~Require the wind-tunnel report to give peak top-floor accelerations for 1-year and 10-year return periods both without a damper and with the TLD represented as equivalent damping, and compare them with ISO 10137 or AIJ habitability curves; the structural designer must also confirm that the roof slab and transfer beams carry full tanks plus sloshing pressure in the governing load combinations.
units.failure: 若把整槽水量直接當成有效質量，會高估質量比約兩成，完工後加速度改善不如預期；水槽若放在模態位移較小的中層設備層，同樣水量的效果也會明顯打折。~Treating the full tank volume as effective mass overstates the mass ratio by about a fifth, so the acceleration improvement after completion falls short; placing tanks on a mid-height plant floor where modal displacement is smaller also sharply reduces the effect of the same water.
units.misconception: 水槽裡的水全部都參與減振，所以水量就等於阻尼器質量。~All the water in the tank takes part in damping, so the water mass equals the damper mass.
units.practice: 建築與機電要在概念設計就協調屋頂水槽的平面、高度與樓板加厚區；水槽兼作消防水源時，消防最低水位與調頻水位要在同一份圖說上分開標示。~Architects and services engineers should coordinate tank footprint, height and thickened roof-slab zones at concept stage; when tanks double as fire-water storage, the fire minimum level and the tuning level must be marked separately on the same drawing.

units.anchor: 第一晃動模態~First sloshing mode
units.title: 線性波浪理論與晃動頻率~Linear wave theory and sloshing frequency
units.mechanism: 矩形水槽受水平擺動時，水會沿槽長方向形成駐波：第一模態是半個波長跨過整個槽長，水面一端升高、另一端下降。晃動頻率由運動方向的內淨長 L 與水深 h 決定，與槽寬及總水量無關；淺水時頻率大致與 √h/L 成正比。水深相對槽長很小的淺水槽在大振幅時會碎波，等效阻尼增加，但頻率也隨振幅略為升高（硬化），所以 TLD 是非線性阻尼器，必須先定義設計振幅。~When a rectangular tank is moved horizontally, the water forms a standing wave along the tank: in the first mode half a wavelength spans the tank length, with the surface rising at one end and falling at the other. The sloshing frequency depends on the internal length L in the direction of motion and the water depth h, not on tank width or total volume; in shallow water it is roughly proportional to √h/L. Shallow tanks break waves at large amplitude, which adds equivalent damping but also raises the frequency slightly (hardening), so a TLD is a nonlinear damper and its design amplitude must be defined first.
units.model: 線性波浪理論 ω² = (πg/L)·tanh(πh/L)。取 L = 6.0 m、h = 0.60 m：πh/L = 0.314，tanh = 0.304，ω² = 5.137×0.304 ≈ 1.563 rad²/s²，ω ≈ 1.250 rad/s，f = ω/2π ≈ 0.199 Hz，可對準 0.20 Hz 的建築模態；若槽長改為 8 m 而水深比不變，f 降為約 0.172 Hz。數值為教學假設。~Linear wave theory gives ω² = (πg/L)·tanh(πh/L). With L = 6.0 m and h = 0.60 m: πh/L = 0.314, tanh = 0.304, ω² = 5.137×0.304 ≈ 1.563 rad²/s², ω ≈ 1.250 rad/s and f = ω/2π ≈ 0.199 Hz, matching a 0.20 Hz building mode; an 8 m tank with the same depth ratio drops to about 0.172 Hz. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 製作單槽樣品放在振動台上做正弦掃頻，以水位計量測槽端波高，找出共振頻率並與公式比較；再以不同振幅重複掃頻，記錄頻率隨振幅升高的幅度與開始碎波的振幅，作為選擇設計振幅的依據。~Put a single prototype tank on a shaking table and run sinusoidal sweeps, measuring wave height at the tank ends with level gauges, find the resonant frequency and compare it with the formula; repeat at several amplitudes and record how much the frequency rises with amplitude and where wave breaking starts, as the basis for choosing the design amplitude.
units.failure: 若以小振幅線性頻率調頻，但設計風速下的振幅讓水槽進入碎波狀態，水槽頻率升高而與建築脫調，減振效果反而在最需要時下降；槽內若有未計入的柱、管線或隔板，也會改變有效槽長與頻率。~Tuning to the small-amplitude linear frequency while the design-wind amplitude drives the tank into wave breaking raises the tank frequency and detunes it from the building, so performance drops exactly when it is needed; columns, pipes or partitions inside the tank that were not modelled also change the effective length and frequency.
units.misconception: 水槽越寬、裝的水越多，晃動頻率就越低。~The wider the tank and the more water it holds, the lower its sloshing frequency.
units.practice: 圖說上應標明每個水槽的內淨長、設計水深與允許偏差（例如水深 ±5 mm），並規定槽內不得穿越管線或增設構件；需要雙向減振時，用正方形或兩向長度不同的水槽分別對準兩個方向的頻率。~Drawings should state each tank's internal length, design water depth and tolerance (for example ±5 mm on depth), and forbid pipes or members inside the tank; where both directions need control, use square tanks or tanks with different lengths in the two directions to match each direction's frequency.

units.title: 液柱阻尼器的幾何與調頻~Liquid-column damper geometry and tuning
units.mechanism: 液柱阻尼器（TLCD）把水放在 U 形管路中：底部水平段的水隨建築擺動被推向一側，兩端垂直段水位一升一降，由重力提供回復力，就像以水為質量的擺。它的頻率只取決於液柱總長，且整段水都參與運動，比淺水晃動容易建立數學模型；控制力來自水平段水的加速度，所以水平段占總長的比例 α 越大，等效質量越有效。費城 Comcast Center 與溫哥華 One Wall Centre 都以大型液柱阻尼器處理風致舒適度。~A tuned liquid column damper (TLCD) holds water in a U-shaped conduit: as the building sways the water in the horizontal leg is pushed to one side and the levels in the two vertical legs rise and fall, with gravity supplying the restoring force like a pendulum whose mass is water. Its frequency depends only on the total column length, and the whole column moves, so it is easier to model than shallow sloshing; the control force comes from accelerating the water in the horizontal leg, so the larger the horizontal length ratio α, the more effective the mass. Comcast Center in Philadelphia and One Wall Centre in Vancouver both use large liquid-column dampers for wind comfort.
units.model: f = (1/2π)·√(2g/L)，故 L = 2g/(2πf)²。f = 0.16 Hz 時 L = 19.62/1.011 ≈ 19.4 m；取水平段比例 α = 0.65，水平段約 12.6 m，兩端垂直段各約 3.4 m。斷面積 10 m² 時水量約 194 t，耦合有效質量約 α²×194 ≈ 82 t。數值為教學假設。~f = (1/2π)·√(2g/L), so L = 2g/(2πf)². For f = 0.16 Hz, L = 19.62/1.011 ≈ 19.4 m; with a horizontal length ratio α = 0.65 the horizontal leg is about 12.6 m and each vertical leg about 3.4 m. With a 10 m² cross-section the water is about 194 t, and the effectively coupled mass is about α²×194 ≈ 82 t. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 施工後先在靜止狀態確認兩端水位相同並複核液柱總長，再以短暫操作閘門造成水位差後釋放，量測垂直段水位的自由振盪週期，換算頻率與設計值比較；斷面有變化時，以等效長度公式重算後再比較。~After construction, confirm at rest that the two end levels match and re-check the total column length, then create a level difference by briefly operating the gate and release it, measure the free-oscillation period of the vertical legs, and compare the derived frequency with design; where the cross-section varies, recompute with an equivalent-length formula before comparing.
units.failure: 若垂直段頂部淨高不足，大振幅時水柱衝出或把空氣壓入水平段，液柱有效長度改變並產生衝擊噪音；兩端若以密閉蓋板封住而未通氣，被壓縮的空氣會變成額外彈簧，把頻率推高而脫調。~If headroom above the vertical legs is insufficient, large amplitudes eject water or drive air into the horizontal leg, changing the effective column length and causing impact noise; sealing the leg tops without venting turns trapped air into an extra spring that pushes the frequency up and detunes the damper.
units.misconception: U 形液柱阻尼器的頻率可以靠加寬水平段來調整。~The frequency of a U-tube damper can be tuned by widening the horizontal leg.
units.practice: 液柱總長、各段斷面變化與通氣口位置要在結構與機電圖上同時標示；垂直段頂部應保留至少等於設計振幅加安全餘裕的淨高，閘門須設在可檢修的位置。~Total column length, cross-section changes and vent locations must appear on both structural and services drawings; leave headroom above each vertical leg at least equal to the design amplitude plus a safety margin, and place the gate where it can be serviced.

units.anchor: 阻尼網與閘門孔口~Damping screens and gate orifice
units.title: 水頭損失與振幅相依阻尼~Head loss and amplitude-dependent damping
units.mechanism: 液體阻尼器的耗能來自水流經孔口、閘門或阻尼網時的紊流水頭損失，損失與流速平方成正比，因此等效阻尼隨振幅增大而增加，不像線性黏滯阻尼是固定值。淺水槽則靠碎波與槽內垂直阻尼網或擋板耗能，阻尼網的開孔率決定損失係數。設計者必須選定代表性振幅（通常是設計回歸期風況下的振幅），讓該處的等效阻尼接近最佳值，並接受其他振幅下偏離最佳。~Dissipation in a liquid damper comes from turbulent head loss as water passes orifices, gates or damping screens; the loss is proportional to velocity squared, so equivalent damping grows with amplitude instead of staying fixed as in a linear viscous damper. Shallow tanks rely on wave breaking and on vertical screens or baffles, whose open-area ratio sets the loss coefficient. The designer must choose a representative amplitude, usually the one in the design-return-period wind, at which equivalent damping is near optimum, and accept departures from the optimum at other amplitudes.
units.model: 以等效線性化，ζ_eq = 2ξ·u₀/(3π·L)。取 L = 19.4 m、水頭損失係數 ξ = 15：液柱振幅 u₀ = 0.50 m 時 ζ_eq = 15/182.9 ≈ 8.2%；u₀ = 0.15 m 時只有約 2.5%。調整閘門開度改變 ξ，就能把最佳阻尼移到另一個設計振幅。數值為教學假設。~By equivalent linearisation, ζ_eq = 2ξ·u₀/(3π·L). With L = 19.4 m and head-loss coefficient ξ = 15, a column amplitude u₀ = 0.50 m gives ζ_eq = 15/182.9 ≈ 8.2%, while u₀ = 0.15 m gives only about 2.5%. Changing the gate opening alters ξ and moves the optimum damping to another design amplitude. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以振動台試驗量測不同振幅下的水位或晃動力時間歷程，計算每循環耗能並換算等效阻尼比，畫出阻尼—振幅曲線；閘門開度與阻尼網開孔率逐檔試驗，確認設計振幅處的等效阻尼落在最佳值的允許範圍內。~On a shaking table record level or sloshing-force histories at several amplitudes, compute energy dissipated per cycle and convert it to an equivalent damping ratio to plot damping against amplitude; test each gate setting and screen open-area ratio to confirm that equivalent damping at the design amplitude lies within the allowed band around the optimum.
units.failure: 阻尼網開孔率太小時，水在小振幅就被鎖住，液體近似附加質量，日常強風幾乎沒有效果；開孔太大則大振幅時阻尼不足，水面振幅超過預留淨高而撞擊槽頂。阻尼網鏽蝕或被沉積物堵塞，也會在不知不覺中改變損失係數。~Screens with too little open area lock the water at small amplitudes so it acts almost as added mass and does little in ordinary strong winds; too much open area leaves too little damping at large amplitude, so the surface excursion exceeds the freeboard and strikes the tank roof. Corroded or clogged screens silently change the loss coefficient as well.
units.misconception: 液體阻尼器的阻尼比和線性黏滯阻尼一樣是固定值，與振幅無關。~A liquid damper's damping ratio is fixed like a linear viscous damper's and does not depend on amplitude.
units.practice: 規範應寫明設計振幅、該振幅下的目標等效阻尼與閘門或阻尼網的可調範圍；阻尼網採不鏽鋼等耐蝕材料並設計成可拆卸清洗，閘門開度須有鎖定裝置並記錄。~The specification should state the design amplitude, the target equivalent damping at that amplitude and the adjustable range of gates or screens; screens should be stainless steel or another corrosion-resistant material and removable for cleaning, and gate settings must be lockable and recorded.

units.anchor: 水槽結構與防水層~Tank structure and waterproofing
units.title: 水槽結構、防水與分階段注水~Tank structure, waterproofing and staged filling
units.mechanism: 數百公噸的水集中在屋頂，水槽本身就是承受靜水壓與晃動動壓的結構：混凝土水槽須控制裂縫寬度並加防水內襯，鋼或玻璃纖維水槽則要處理接縫與防蝕。滿水重量經槽底樓板、梁與柱傳到核心筒，屋頂樓板常需加厚或增設轉換梁。注水必須分階段進行，一方面確認樓板撓度與滲漏，一方面在每個水位量測頻率，逐步逼近調頻水位。~Several hundred tonnes of water concentrated on the roof make each tank a structure that resists hydrostatic and sloshing pressure: concrete tanks need crack-width control and a waterproof liner, while steel or glass-fibre tanks need attention to joints and corrosion protection. The full weight travels through the tank floor, beams and columns to the core, so roof slabs are often thickened or given transfer beams. Filling is done in stages, both to check slab deflection and leakage and to measure frequency at each level while approaching the tuning depth.
units.model: 靜水壓 p = ρgh。液柱垂直段靜水深 4.0 m 加上 0.5 m 振幅，最大水頭 4.5 m：p = 1,000×9.81×4.5 ≈ 44.1 kPa，槽壁每延米合力 F = ½ρgh² = 0.5×9,810×4.5² ≈ 99.3 kN/m；194 t 的水對屋頂結構另增約 1,900 kN 的重量。數值為教學假設。~Hydrostatic pressure p = ρgh. With 4.0 m of still water in a vertical leg plus 0.5 m amplitude, the maximum head is 4.5 m: p = 1,000×9.81×4.5 ≈ 44.1 kPa and the wall resultant per metre is F = ½ρgh² = 0.5×9,810×4.5² ≈ 99.3 kN/m; the 194 t of water adds about 1,900 kN of weight to the roof structure. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 注水前對防水層與接縫做目視與真空箱或電火花檢漏，注水分 25%、50%、75%、100% 四階段，每階段靜置後量測樓板撓度、水位下降量與槽外滲漏，撓度與滲漏都在允收值內才進入下一階段。~Before filling, inspect the liner and joints visually and by vacuum-box or spark testing; fill in four stages of 25%, 50%, 75% and 100%, and after each hold measure slab deflection, level drop and external seepage, proceeding only when deflection and leakage are within acceptance limits.
units.failure: 混凝土水槽若未控制乾縮與溫度裂縫，滿水後滲漏會進入下層住戶或機電空間，持續失水又使阻尼器脫調；一次注滿而不分階段，可能在發現樓板撓度異常前就已造成裂縫。~Concrete tanks without control of shrinkage and thermal cracking leak into the dwellings or plant rooms below once full, and the continuous loss of water also detunes the damper; filling in one go may crack the slab before abnormal deflection is noticed.
units.misconception: 水槽只是裝水的容器，不需要當成結構構件設計。~A tank is just a water container and need not be designed as a structural member.
units.practice: 水槽施工計畫要列出注水分段、每段持壓時間、撓度與滲漏的停止條件，並由結構設計者與防水承包商共同簽認；注水試驗期間，水槽下方樓層應暫緩精裝修。~The tank construction plan should list filling stages, hold times and stop criteria for deflection and leakage, signed by both the structural designer and the waterproofing contractor; finishes on the floor below should be held back during the fill test.

units.title: 實測建築頻率與現場調頻~Measured building frequency and field tuning
units.mechanism: 完工建築的實際頻率常與分析值不同；One Wall Centre 的公開報導指出，建築與液柱阻尼器頻率須相差 10% 以內才有效，而其分析與第 41 層實測頻率相差約 3.2%。TLD 最大的優點是現場調頻容易：淺水槽改變水深，液柱阻尼器改變水量或液柱長度，即可移動頻率；但水深降低時參與的水也減少，質量比隨之下降，調頻與有效質量必須一起檢查。~The real frequency of a completed building often differs from analysis; published accounts of One Wall Centre note that building and liquid-column damper frequencies must be within 10% for the damper to work, and that analysis and measurement at level 41 agreed within about 3.2%. The great advantage of a TLD is easy field tuning: changing water depth in a shallow tank, or water volume or column length in a column damper, shifts the frequency; but lowering the depth also removes water and lowers the mass ratio, so tuning and effective mass must be checked together.
units.model: 若建築實測 f₁ = 0.185 Hz（設計 0.20 Hz），目標槽頻 f = 0.185/(1+0.015) ≈ 0.182 Hz，ω² = 1.312；tanh(πh/L) = ω²L/(πg) = 1.312×6/30.82 ≈ 0.255，πh/L ≈ 0.261，h ≈ 0.50 m。40 槽總水量由 576 降為約 479 m³，有效質量比降為約 1.26%，需增至約 48 槽才回到 1.5%。數值為教學假設。~If the measured f₁ = 0.185 Hz instead of the design 0.20 Hz, the target tank frequency is 0.185/(1+0.015) ≈ 0.182 Hz and ω² = 1.312; tanh(πh/L) = ω²L/(πg) = 1.312×6/30.82 ≈ 0.255, so πh/L ≈ 0.261 and h ≈ 0.50 m. The water in 40 tanks drops from 576 to about 479 m³ and the effective mass ratio to about 1.26%, so about 48 tanks are needed to return to 1.5%. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以環境振動量測，在水槽排空或閘門鎖住時與注水後分別辨識建築頻率；再以水位計量測各槽自由晃動頻率，確認全部水槽落在目標值 ±2% 內，最後記錄每槽實際水深作為交接基準。~Identify the building frequency from ambient vibration both with tanks empty or gates locked and after filling; then measure the free-sloshing frequency of each tank with level gauges, confirm all tanks are within ±2% of the target, and record each tank's actual depth as the handover baseline.
units.failure: 只把水深調到頻率吻合而沒有重算有效質量，有效質量比可能少約 16%，等效阻尼隨之下降；各槽水深若不一致，水槽頻率分散，整體表現像許多小阻尼器各自為政，峰值降低有限。~Adjusting depth only for frequency without recomputing effective mass can leave the effective mass ratio about 16% short, with equivalent damping falling accordingly; inconsistent depths across tanks scatter their frequencies, so the array behaves like many small dampers acting independently and the peak reduction is limited.
units.misconception: 液體阻尼器調頻只要改水深，對質量比沒有影響。~Retuning a liquid damper by changing water depth has no effect on its mass ratio.
units.practice: 設計階段就預留增設水槽的空間與樓板承載，或把水槽設計成可在一段水深範圍內工作；調頻作業安排在帷幕牆與主要裝修完成後，並把每槽水深、水位計零點與實測頻率列表交接。~Reserve space and slab capacity for extra tanks at design stage, or design tanks to work across a range of depths; carry out tuning after the façade and major fit-out are complete, and hand over a table of each tank's depth, gauge zero and measured frequency.

units.anchor: 縮尺水槽振動台試驗~Scaled tank shaking-table test
units.title: 福祿數相似律與模型試驗~Froude similitude and model testing
units.mechanism: 晃動由重力主導，縮尺試驗必須維持福祿數相同：幾何縮小 λ 倍時，頻率放大 √λ 倍、時間縮短 √λ 倍、振幅縮小 λ 倍。這讓工程師能在實驗室振動台上以小水槽重現碎波與阻尼網效果，One Rincon Hill 的水槽即曾在加拿大西安大略大學測試。但雷諾數無法同時相似，小模型的黏性損失相對偏大，阻尼網的損失係數最好以接近實尺度的樣品校核。~Sloshing is gravity-dominated, so scaled tests must preserve the Froude number: shrinking geometry by λ raises frequency by √λ, shortens time by √λ and reduces amplitude by λ. This lets engineers reproduce wave breaking and screen effects with small tanks on a laboratory shaking table; the tanks for One Rincon Hill were tested at the University of Western Ontario. Reynolds number cannot be matched at the same time, so viscous losses are relatively larger in small models, and screen loss coefficients are best checked with near-full-scale samples.
units.model: 實尺度槽 L = 6.0 m、h = 0.60 m、f_p ≈ 0.199 Hz；以 λ = 5 縮尺為 L = 1.2 m、h = 0.12 m，模型頻率 f_m = f_p·√5 ≈ 0.445 Hz；實尺度 0.10 m 的建築振幅在模型中只需 0.02 m，10 分鐘的實尺度風暴對應約 600/√5 ≈ 268 s。數值為教學假設。~A full-scale tank with L = 6.0 m, h = 0.60 m and f_p ≈ 0.199 Hz becomes L = 1.2 m and h = 0.12 m at λ = 5; the model frequency is f_m = f_p·√5 ≈ 0.445 Hz, a 0.10 m full-scale building amplitude needs only 0.02 m in the model, and a 10-minute full-scale storm corresponds to about 600/√5 ≈ 268 s. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 振動台以實測或合成的建築頂部位移歷時驅動模型水槽，以荷重元量測槽底水平力、以波高計量測水面，計算力與位移的相位與每循環耗能；結果換算回實尺度後，與數值模型預測的等效阻尼比較，差異須能解釋。~Drive the model tank on the shaking table with measured or synthetic top-floor displacement histories, measure base shear with load cells and the free surface with wave gauges, and compute the force–displacement phase and energy per cycle; scale the results back to full size and compare the equivalent damping with numerical predictions, requiring explainable differences.
units.failure: 若縮尺試驗沿用實尺度水深而只縮小平面，頻率與碎波行為都不相似，得到的阻尼會誤導設計；只做正弦試驗而不做隨機激振，也可能高估實際風況下的效果。~Scaling only the plan while keeping full-scale depth makes neither frequency nor wave breaking similar, and the damping obtained misleads the design; running only sinusoidal tests without random excitation can also overstate performance in real wind.
units.misconception: 縮尺模型的水深可以和實尺度相同，只要縮小平面尺寸即可。~A scaled model can keep the full-scale water depth and simply shrink the plan dimensions.
units.practice: 試驗計畫應列出相似律、縮尺比、輸入歷時、量測儀器與允收比較方式並保留原始資料；阻尼網或閘門的設計值，須經接近實尺度的元件試驗確認後才定案。~The test plan should list the similitude law, scale, input histories, instruments and acceptance comparison, and keep raw data; screen or gate design values should be fixed only after near-full-scale component tests.

units.anchor: 波高計與頂層加速度計~Wave gauges and roof accelerometers
units.title: 完工監測與等效阻尼識別~Post-completion monitoring and equivalent-damping identification
units.mechanism: 完工後要證明水槽在真實風況下有效，需要同時量測建築頂層加速度、各水槽水位與風速風向。水位與建築位移的相位差可判斷是否調諧：接近共振時，水面晃動落後建築約 90 度；加速度紀錄則以隨機遞減法或系統識別求出含 TLD 的總阻尼比。由於 TLD 是非線性，阻尼比必須依振幅分組比較，不能只報一個數字。~To prove the tanks work in real wind after completion, measure roof acceleration, the water level in the tanks and wind speed and direction at the same time. The phase between water level and building displacement shows whether the damper is tuned: near resonance the sloshing lags the building by about 90 degrees; the acceleration records give the total damping ratio including the TLD by the random-decrement method or system identification. Because a TLD is nonlinear, damping must be grouped and compared by amplitude rather than reported as a single number.
units.model: 對寬頻風力，均方根加速度約與 1/√ζ_total 成正比。結構阻尼 1.5%、加裝 TLD 後總阻尼 4.0% 時，加速度比 = √(1.5/4.0) ≈ 0.61，約降低 39%；若實測總阻尼只有 3.0%，比值為 √(1.5/3.0) ≈ 0.71，降幅縮為約 29%。數值為教學假設。~For broadband wind forcing, RMS acceleration is roughly proportional to 1/√ζ_total. With 1.5% structural damping and 4.0% total damping with the TLD, the acceleration ratio is √(1.5/4.0) ≈ 0.61, a reduction of about 39%; if only 3.0% total damping is measured, the ratio is √(1.5/3.0) ≈ 0.71 and the reduction shrinks to about 29%. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 監測至少涵蓋一個強風季節，把每段 10 分鐘紀錄依頂層加速度振幅分組，求出各組的頻率與總阻尼，與設計的阻尼—振幅曲線比較；必要時短暫降低水位或鎖住閘門做對照量測，確認差異來自阻尼器而非風況變化。~Monitor through at least one windy season, group 10-minute records by roof acceleration amplitude, identify frequency and total damping for each group, and compare with the design damping–amplitude curve; where needed briefly lower the water or lock the gates for a comparison run to confirm the difference comes from the damper rather than changing wind.
units.failure: 若只用低風速的環境振動資料識別阻尼，振幅太小使 TLD 幾乎不耗能，會誤判阻尼器無效；反之只挑幾次強風事件，又可能把風況差異誤當成阻尼器效果。~Identifying damping only from low-wind ambient data, where amplitudes are too small for the TLD to dissipate much, wrongly suggests the damper is ineffective; picking only a few strong-wind events can instead mistake differences in wind for damper performance.
units.misconception: 只要在無風的日子量一次建築阻尼，就能證明液體阻尼器有效。~A single damping measurement on a calm day proves that a liquid damper works.
units.practice: 監測報告要附各水槽水位、建築加速度與風資料的同步時間軸，並列明分組方式與識別方法；業主驗收應以設計振幅附近的資料為準，而非全部資料的平均。~The monitoring report should include a synchronised timeline of tank levels, building acceleration and wind data and state the grouping and identification methods; owner acceptance should rest on data near the design amplitude rather than on an average of all records.

units.anchor: 補水與水質管理~Make-up water and water quality
units.title: 蒸發、水質與防凍~Evaporation, water quality and freeze protection
units.mechanism: TLD 的質量就是水，水量變化就是調頻變化：通氣水槽會蒸發，閥門或接縫會滲漏，寒冷地區水面可能結冰，冰層不但改變晃動形態，也會讓阻尼網與水位計失效。靜止水體容易滋生藻類與微生物，常需添加殺菌劑或防凍劑，但添加物會改變密度與黏性，也可能腐蝕金屬阻尼網。水槽兼作消防水源時，火災後若未補足抽用的水，阻尼器會長期脫調。~A TLD's mass is its water, so any change in water is a change in tuning: vented tanks evaporate, valves and joints leak, and in cold climates the surface can freeze, which alters sloshing and disables screens and level gauges. Still water breeds algae and microbes, so biocides or antifreeze are often added, but additives change density and viscosity and may corrode metal screens. When the tanks double as fire storage, failing to refill after a fire draw-down leaves the damper detuned for a long time.
units.model: 40 槽總水面約 960 m²，若日蒸發 1 mm，每月損失約 0.96×30 ≈ 28.8 m³，即 576 m³ 的 5%，水深由 0.60 m 降到 0.57 m。tanh(π×0.57/6) = 0.290，頻率比 √(0.290/0.304) ≈ 0.976，頻率約下降 2.4%（0.199 → 0.194 Hz）。數值為教學假設。~The 40 tanks expose about 960 m² of water; at 1 mm of evaporation per day the monthly loss is about 0.96×30 ≈ 28.8 m³, 5% of 576 m³, lowering the depth from 0.60 m to 0.57 m. With tanh(π×0.57/6) = 0.290, the frequency ratio is √(0.290/0.304) ≈ 0.976, a drop of about 2.4% (0.199 to 0.194 Hz). Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 每槽設連續水位計並設定上下限警報（例如偏離調頻水位 ±10 mm），記錄自動補水閥的動作次數與補水量；每季取樣檢驗水質、添加劑濃度與密度，每年目視檢查阻尼網鏽蝕與沉積。~Fit each tank with a continuous level gauge and alarms at upper and lower limits (for example ±10 mm from the tuning level), and log auto-fill valve operations and volumes; sample water quality, additive concentration and density quarterly, and inspect screens for corrosion and deposits each year.
units.failure: 補水閥故障或水位計漂移時，水位慢慢下降數公分，建築照常使用卻已脫調，直到強風季住戶抱怨才被發現；加入防凍液而未重算密度與黏性，也會讓頻率與阻尼偏離試驗基準。~A failed fill valve or drifting gauge lets the level fall a few centimetres; the building stays in normal use but detuned until occupants complain in the windy season; adding antifreeze without recomputing density and viscosity also shifts frequency and damping away from the test baseline.
units.misconception: 水槽裡的水只要沒有漏光，阻尼器性能就不會改變。~As long as the tank does not run dry, the damper's performance does not change.
units.practice: 維護手冊要把調頻水位、消防最低水位與溢流水位分別標示，並規定任何添加劑、清洗或排水作業前須通知結構顧問；水位警報應接到中央監控室。~The maintenance manual should mark the tuning level, fire minimum level and overflow level separately, and require the structural consultant to be notified before any additive, cleaning or drainage work; level alarms should report to the central control room.

units.anchor: 出水高度與槽頂~Freeboard and tank roof
units.title: 極端事件、出水高度與交接~Extreme events, freeboard and handover
units.mechanism: 颱風或地震時，水面振幅可能遠超過舒適度設計振幅，水面撞擊槽頂會產生衝擊壓力，濺出的水則造成屋頂積水與水量流失。設計須在兩種策略中擇一：保留足夠出水高度讓水自由晃動，或把槽頂設計成承受衝擊的結構。地震時 TLD 也會把晃動動壓傳回結構，須納入屋頂構件設計；事件後的檢查與交接文件，決定阻尼器能否迅速回到調頻狀態。~In a typhoon or earthquake the surface excursion can far exceed the comfort-design amplitude; water striking the tank roof produces impact pressure, and spillage floods the roof and loses water. Design must adopt one of two strategies: enough freeboard for free sloshing, or a tank roof designed for impact. In an earthquake the TLD also returns sloshing pressure to the structure, which must be included in roof member design; post-event inspection and handover documents decide whether the damper can quickly return to its tuned state.
units.model: 以線性化估計 η ≈ (L/2)·(S_a/g)。槽長 L = 6.0 m、晃動頻率處的樓頂譜加速度 S_a = 0.15 g 時，η ≈ 3.0×0.15 = 0.45 m；水深 0.60 m 時槽內淨高至少約 1.05 m，若只做到 0.90 m，槽頂須按衝擊壓力設計。數值為教學假設。~A linearised estimate is η ≈ (L/2)·(S_a/g). For L = 6.0 m and a roof spectral acceleration S_a = 0.15 g at the sloshing frequency, η ≈ 3.0×0.15 = 0.45 m; with 0.60 m of water the internal height should be at least about 1.05 m, and if only 0.90 m is provided the tank roof must be designed for impact pressure. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以非線性時間歷程或計算流體力學檢查設計颱風與地震下的最大波高、衝擊次數與槽壁動壓，並複核屋頂構件；事件後依檢查表查看溢水痕跡、阻尼網變形、水位與水質，並以監測資料重新確認頻率比。~Check maximum wave height, impact count and dynamic wall pressure under design typhoon and earthquake records with nonlinear time-history analysis or computational fluid dynamics, and verify the roof members; after an event, follow a checklist for spill marks, screen deformation, water level and quality, and reconfirm the frequency ratio from monitoring data.
units.failure: 出水高度不足而槽頂又按一般屋頂設計時，強震中的衝擊壓力可能破壞槽頂或接縫，大量溢水流入下方樓層；事件後若未補水重調，阻尼器到下一個颱風季仍處於脫調狀態。~With too little freeboard and a tank roof designed as an ordinary roof, impact pressure in a strong earthquake can break the roof or joints and spill large volumes into the floors below; without refilling and retuning afterwards, the damper stays detuned into the next typhoon season.
units.misconception: 水槽只在強風時晃動，地震時不會對結構產生額外的力。~Tanks slosh only in strong wind and add no force to the structure in an earthquake.
units.practice: 交接文件應包含每槽尺寸、調頻水位、阻尼網規格、試驗與監測基準、事件後檢查表與補水程序；建築改裝若改變屋頂設備重量或核心勁度，須由結構顧問重新評估調頻並核可。~Handover documents should include each tank's dimensions, tuning level, screen specification, test and monitoring baselines, the post-event checklist and refilling procedure; renovations that change roof equipment weight or core stiffness require the structural consultant to reassess and approve the tuning.

example: 設計練習：某住宅塔樓第一模態 f₁ = 0.20 Hz、結構阻尼 1.5%、頂部廣義質量 M* = 30,000 t，目標有效質量比 μ = 1.5%，即 m_eff = 450 t。選用內淨長 L = 6.0 m、水深 h = 0.60 m 的淺水槽：ω² = (πg/L)·tanh(πh/L) = 5.137×0.304 ≈ 1.563 rad²/s²，f ≈ 0.199 Hz；第一晃動模態參與比例 8·tanh(πh/L)/(π³·h/L) = 8×0.304/3.10 ≈ 0.785，故總水量約 450/0.785 ≈ 573 t。每槽 6 m × 4 m × 0.60 m = 14.4 m³，40 槽共 576 m³。若加裝後總阻尼達 4.0%，均方根加速度約降為 √(1.5/4.0) ≈ 61%。若完工實測 f₁ 只有 0.185 Hz，水深須降到約 0.50 m，水量減為約 479 m³，有效質量比只剩約 1.26%，必須增至約 48 槽才能回到原目標。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築的設計。~Design exercise: a residential tower has f₁ = 0.20 Hz, 1.5% structural damping and a top generalised mass M* = 30,000 t, with a target effective mass ratio μ = 1.5%, so m_eff = 450 t. Choose shallow tanks with internal length L = 6.0 m and water depth h = 0.60 m: ω² = (πg/L)·tanh(πh/L) = 5.137×0.304 ≈ 1.563 rad²/s², so f ≈ 0.199 Hz; the first-mode participation ratio 8·tanh(πh/L)/(π³·h/L) = 8×0.304/3.10 ≈ 0.785, so the total water is about 450/0.785 ≈ 573 t. Each tank holds 6 m × 4 m × 0.60 m = 14.4 m³, and 40 tanks hold 576 m³. If total damping reaches 4.0% with the dampers, RMS acceleration falls to about √(1.5/4.0) ≈ 61%. If the completed building measures only 0.185 Hz, the depth must drop to about 0.50 m, the water to about 479 m³ and the effective mass ratio to about 1.26%, so about 48 tanks are needed to restore the target. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real building.
history: 液體晃動減振與船舶抗橫搖水艙的原理相近，而調諧液體阻尼器用於土木結構最早在日本實現，長崎機場塔台、橫濱海洋塔、新橫濱王子飯店與東京國際機場塔台都是常被引用的早期案例；1989 年 Fujino 等人在 Damping '89 研討會發表淺水槽阻尼器研究，同年 Sakai 與 Takaeda 提出液柱阻尼器構想。北美方面，2001 年完工的溫哥華 One Wall Centre 在頂部設置兩座各約 50,000 加侖的液柱阻尼器，2008 年完工的費城 Comcast Center 則採用超過 1,300 公噸水量的液柱阻尼器。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。~Liquid sloshing damping shares its principle with ships' anti-roll tanks, and tuned liquid dampers were first applied to civil structures in Japan, with Nagasaki Airport Tower, Yokohama Marine Tower, Shin-Yokohama Prince Hotel and Tokyo International Airport Tower often cited as early cases; in 1989 Fujino and co-workers presented shallow-tank damper research at the Damping '89 conference, and in the same year Sakai and Takaeda proposed the liquid-column damper. In North America, One Wall Centre in Vancouver, completed in 2001, placed two liquid-column dampers of about 50,000 gallons each at its top, and Comcast Center in Philadelphia, completed in 2008, adopted a liquid-column damper holding over 1,300 tons of water. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
facts: Comcast Center 的液柱阻尼器水量超過 1,300 公噸，風工程顧問 RWDI 稱為同類中最大~Comcast Center's liquid-column damper holds over 1,300 tons of water, described by RWDI as the largest of its kind
Comcast Center 建築高度約 297 m、地上 57 層，2008 年完工~Comcast Center is about 297 m tall with 57 floors above ground and was completed in 2008
One Wall Centre 頂部有兩座液柱阻尼器，各高四層、各約 50,000 加侖（約 189 m³）~One Wall Centre has two liquid-column dampers at its top, each four storeys high and holding about 50,000 gallons (about 189 m³)
One Wall Centre 高約 137 m（450 ft）、48 層，2001 年完工；建築與阻尼器頻率須相差 10% 以內~One Wall Centre is about 137 m (450 ft) tall with 48 storeys, completed in 2001; building and damper frequencies must be within 10%

One Rincon Hill 風洞預測加速度約 25 milli-g，高於住宅可接受的 15 至 18 milli-g，因而採用水槽阻尼器~Wind tests for One Rincon Hill predicted about 25 milli-g against an acceptable residential 15 to 18 milli-g, leading to a water-tank damper
液體阻尼器常見質量比約 1% 至 2%，質量比 1% 時反應可降低至多約 50%~Liquid dampers typically use mass ratios of about 1% to 2%, and a 1% mass ratio can cut response by up to about 50%
0.16 Hz 的液柱阻尼器約需 20 m 液柱總長，水平段比例常取 0.6 至 0.7~A 0.16 Hz liquid-column damper needs about 20 m of total column length, with a horizontal length ratio usually 0.6 to 0.7
水深與槽長比 h/L = 0.1 的矩形水槽，約 78.5% 的水參與第一晃動模態~In a rectangular tank with depth-to-length ratio h/L = 0.1, about 78.5% of the water joins the first sloshing mode
